title: Republicans have 'growing litany list' against Trump
summary: US President Donald ​Trump faced pointed criticism over the Iran war on Wednesday in a closed-door meeting with fellow Republicans, with Trump reportedly engaging in a shouting match with Republican Senator Bill Cassidy. It was another sign, says France 24's Douglas Herbert, of growing dissatisfaction with the president among some Republicans.
